label: 敲入引发的对冲抛压(2024年1月市场人士说法)
value: 指数下跌触发雪球敲入，导致股指期货被强制卖出，进一步加大下跌压力
source: 路透社《Snowball derivatives feed China stock market avalanche》(2024-01-23，雅虎财经转载)
quote: the drop triggered knock-in levels on snowball products, leading to forced selling of stock futures contracts which further pressured the market
note: 市场人士说法，路透转述

label: 监管要求大型券商暂停增加场外衍生品净敞口(匿名消息，2024年4月)
value: 要求一些最大的券商暂停增加挂钩A股的场外衍生品净敞口，包括雪球
source: 彭博社《China tells brokers to limit exposure to snowball derivatives》(CNBC-TV18转载，页面标注2024-04-24)
quote: told some of the biggest brokerages to suspend any increase in their net exposure to over-the-counter derivatives involving domestic A shares, including snowball products
note: 匿名知情人士消息，限制是暂时的，未说明何时放松；彭博稿

label: 雪球票息价格战(2024年4月稿件)
value: 上月发行的两只雪球票息超过40%
source: 彭博社《China tells brokers to limit exposure to snowball derivatives》(CNBC-TV18转载，页面标注2024-04-24)
quote: two snowball products issued last month offered coupon rates of more than 40%
note: 数据来自银河科技(Galaxy Technologies)，未具名发行人；彭博稿
